_documentation.purpose: All possible relics. Players can equip only relic IDs listed in character.unlockedRelics.

frost_lens.name: Frost Lens
frost_lens.effect: Ice words slow enemies for 1 extra turn.

quill_of_echoes.name: Quill of Echoes
quill_of_echoes.effect: The first repeated letter in a word adds bonus damage.

glass_heart.name: Glass Heart
glass_heart.effect: Gain a shield after using an 8-letter word.

tower_compass.name: Tower Compass
tower_compass.effect: Reveal one enemy weakness at the start of a floor.

veil_candle.name: Veil Candle
veil_candle.effect: Dark words have increased critical chance.
